decisions.reason: Its close fit with existing ceiling luminaires and two years of market learning give the firm strong absorptive capacity to improve and retain it.
As a flexible variant of established track spotlights, the firm can readily interpret early results and apply its related lighting knowledge, so withdrawal risk remains low.
The multi-outlet canopy builds on the firm's modular system know-how, though it is more peripheral, so the firm has moderate capacity to learn from its first year.
Low-voltage canopies require somewhat more specialized electrical knowledge, reducing the firm's related absorptive capacity relative to core luminaires, but still manageable.
Round glass track luminaires are close to existing track lighting but have received less presentation, limiting early learning and raising withdrawal risk compared with dedicated pages.
